questions.answer: Yes; people may prefer different kinds of connection.

scoring.knowledge: 1 point per correct answer; formative only; use answer-specific feedback.
scoring.practice: Designs sustainable opportunities for recurring contact and distinguishes opportunity from mutual friendship outcomes.
